provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Here to Slay rulebook (Unstable Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Each player chooses a Party Leader into their Party (roll for pick order if you like)
Each player may take a rules reference card; box the rest
Shuffle the standard-size cards; deal {n} to each player; rest facedown as the main deck, room for a discard pile
Shuffle the Monsters; {n} faceup in the center, the rest facedown as the Monster deck
Win by slaying 3 Monsters or ending your turn with 6 different classes in your Party
Whoever picked their Party Leader last goes first
